title: iPhone 17 Pro Max Hexagon Case + Camera Bump
author: h2d_X2d_girl
description:
Update 20.09.2025 : Due to the inquiries, I have added a print profile for a camera protection

Hello, to shorten the waiting time until the new iPhones are released, I have already designed cases for the new iPhone models based on my previous iPhone cases. Fortunately, the new iPhones are almost identical in dimensions to the others. I have adapted everything to the new models, but please feel free to let me know in the comments if anything should be changed. If you look at the cases on my profile, you will read in the comments that they fit almost perfectly, and that should also be the case with the new models. I hope you print them and then give me your feedback :) If you are satisfied, you are welcome to leave a boost.

Please note that the quality and successful printing **always** depend on the **material** used for my models and print profiles! I use Highspeed PLA+ for all prints
